contributions.detail: Schedule A (PDF p3) carries TWO entries on lines 1 and 2 of a 17-line grid: 200.00 + 193.90 = 393.90 exactly = the schedule's printed subtotal = its printed total = the cover's promoted per-period Column A cell. THE IN-KIND CONVENTION IS MONETARY-PLUS-IN-KIND: line 1 is marked '(in-Kind)' by the filer beside the amount and it is INSIDE the printed 393.90 — cash-only would leave 193.90, which the document never states. The balance ladder closes: line 3 beginning 18,378.67 + line 4 393.90 = line 5 18,772.57; minus line 6 12,935.93 = line 7 5,836.64. Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' prints 56,295.79, a genuine cycle cumulative on this 30-days-after-Primary report, and is never summed as an increment. The unused remainder of the grid is crossed out with several large looping strokes — the §E3 CONTRAST CASE: a stroke across the LEFTOVER grid, which voids no row, consumes no line and shifts no index (crop-proved: the entry on band 1 is intact and band 3 is empty).

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' line 2 TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE ($12,935.93) on the p2 Summary Page, equal to Schedule B's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' 12,935.93 and its printed 'Total Expenditures Received' 12,935.93
expenditures.detail: Schedule B (PDF p4) carries FIFTEEN entries filling lines 1-15 of its 17-line grid: 6128.79 + 1.10 + 750.00 + 18.85 + 159.80 + 2.99 + 29.00 + 326.05 + 3000.00 + 750.00 + 150.00 + 325.75 + 941.60 + 349.00 + 3.00 = 12,935.93 exactly = the printed page subtotal = the printed total = Column A, and the same figure is repeated on the cover at line 6. No in-kind item is marked on this side, so both conventions coincide. Column B YTD prints 50,459.15 and is not summed. A single long wavy stroke runs across the two unused lines below the last entry — again a leftover-grid stroke, not a voided row (the one-past-the-end control rendered an empty amount cell).

in_kind_convention: monetary-PLUS-in-kind on the contributions side; not applicable on the expenditures side. Tested on BOTH sides of THIS filing (§G1): Schedule A closes only WITH the 200.00 the filer marked '(in-Kind)' (cash-only leaves 193.90 against a printed 393.90), while Schedule B marks nothing in-kind and closes at 12,935.93 either way. Note the in-kind gift is NOT mirrored as an offsetting expenditure here — unlike McCabe 2018 in this same chunk, whose three in-kind items appear on both sides.
escalation_note: One escalation, on the p4 line-9 payee cell, whose dense cursive was cropped at 1400 dpi: it reads 'Syzygy Solutions' with '(campaign phone calls)' bracketed after it, though the letterforms would also support a literal 'Sygzgs' and that doubt is recorded on the row rather than resolved. No AMOUNT was in doubt: both schedules close to the cent on their own printed subtotals and totals AND on the cover's Column A cells, and the cover's balance ladder closes as well, so every figure is corroborated three ways inside the document. The remaining crops recorded in the frames are geometry proofs.

3.measure_note: legacy_colAB UNDERLINE form, text ABOVE its rule; the sheet is perfectly square (skew 0.0, drift 0.0) so the full-width rowbands.py ladder was used: 17 rules 21.57 / 25.48 / 29.34 / 33.20 / 37.09 / 40.95 / 44.84 / 48.70 / 52.57 / 56.45 / 60.32 / 64.18 / 68.09 / 71.98 / 75.82 / 79.73 / 83.61 at pitch 3.88, with four segments per rule giving the column bands; row 1 is extrapolated one pitch up to 17.66. Seventeen lines, of which the filer used two. THREE-CROP PROOF at 1200 dpi --value (taken slightly wider than the stored band, to 95.0, so the filer's marginal annotations show): row 1 rendered the printed 'Amount' header over '$200.00' followed by the start of his '(in-Kind)' note; row 2 rendered '$193.90' followed by the start of '($200 less PayPal fee)'; and the §B5 one-past-the-end control on row 3 rendered an EMPTY amount cell with only the tail of a looping cross-out stroke — the proof that the strokes across the unused grid are leftover-grid marks and not voided rows (§E3 contrast). The stored `cell` is the PRINTED amount column, which contains the figures themselves; the filer's parenthetical annotations sit outside it to the right and are recorded on the rows as notes rather than as values.

4.measure_note: Same form, skew -0.2 with 0.27 drift, full-width ladder used: 17 rules 23.64 ... 85.68 at pitch 3.88; row 1 extrapolated one pitch up to 19.76. Fifteen entries fill lines 1-15 one-to-one — this filer wraps each vendor's street line UPWARD into the space above its own row rather than onto the next line, so there is no continuation line and no index shift on this page. THREE-CROP PROOF at 1200 dpi --value: row 1 pct:82.3,19.76,13.0,3.88@p4 rendered the 'Amount' header over '$6,128.79'; row 15 pct:82.3,74.05,13.0,3.86@p4 rendered '$3.00' (the last transcribed row); and the §B5 one-past-the-end control on row 16 rendered an EMPTY amount cell crossed only by the filer's single wavy leftover-grid stroke. Two further strip crops at 1200-1400 dpi read the line-9 and line-14 payee cells, whose text runs onto two lines inside one printed row; both are recorded on their rows. No band on either page is ~2x pitch, so no doubled band (§F6/§H3).

notes: PAGE-FACE candidate 'Chad Grunander' (handwritten), party 'Republican', residence Provo; Office Seeking written 'Utah County Attorney', which agrees with index.csv's channel label 'County Attorney'. index.csv names no candidate; the page face supplies it. Report type '30 Days after the Primary Election (if eliminated at the Primary)' — consistent with the index period label 'Out at Primary'; amendment answered 'No'; signed and dated 7/25/2018, with the same date in the Date of Report box on all three inner sheets. The clerk's 'For Office Use Only' box is EMPTY — no received stamp of any kind. FORM STOCK: the cover is the county-only title 'FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY CANDIDATES' with the Code 2-5 & 17-16-6.5 citation (its side rail reads 'County & Local School Candidates'), and all three inner sheets are strap-lined '2018 County & Local School Candidates' — GENUINELY 2018-DATED stock, the same third 2018 wording as the Phelps filing in this chunk. Schedule B's payee column is headed 'Provider/Vendor'; neither schedule has a Purpose column. DOCUMENT SHAPE: 4 pages = cover / SUMMARY PAGE / Schedule A / Schedule B, and here the summary IS at p2 — but it was located by its printed heading, and note the filer felt the need to hand-write '(Summary page)' beside the foliation box. FOLIATION: each of the three inner sheets is numbered 'Page 1 of 1' independently — an ELEVENTH practice for the running tally, and one that says nothing about the document as a whole. ROW-INDEX TRAPS SCREENED: on both schedules the first written entry is band 1 (crop-proved), there is no banner and no continuation line, and the §B5 one-past control rendered an empty amount cell on each. ⚠ BOTH SCHEDULES CARRY LARGE PEN STROKES ACROSS THEIR UNUSED GRID — several big loops on Schedule A and one long wave on Schedule B — and both are §E3 LEFTOVER-GRID strokes, not voided rows: they cross empty lines only, void nothing, and shift no index, which the control crops confirm. FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN: columns assigned by CONTENT against the printed headings. Two departures are recorded on their rows and neither makes a column unassignable — one expenditure cell names no payee at all (only what the payment was for, with 'Online' in the address column), and the filer's amount-cell annotations ('(in-Kind)', '($200 less PayPal fee)') sit OUTSIDE the printed amount column to its right. PRIVACY: this filing is NOT redacted and prints full mailing lines for both donors and every vendor; the two contribution rows were reduced to city/state at READ TIME, expenditure rows carry no address field in this record, and no street line was written into any field or note.
